summary_1line: Parvati proves her unwavering devotion to Siva, passes his disguised test, gains his acceptance, and preparations begin for their formal marriage.

image_candidates.scene_text: Parvati calmly sits in meditation as the disguised old monk Siva approaches her hermitage leaning on a staff.
Parvati steps into a blazing fire during her vow, yet the flames cool harmlessly around her body.
Siva briefly reveals multiple divine forms—Vishnu with four arms and then Nataraja dancing—before vanishing before the astonished crowd.
